Flow.description:
★R9 Tells the next level of the approval chain that it has work. Each approval step's approval action advances Current_Level__c, which is the moment the level above becomes involved; this Flow turns that update into one aggregated notification per approver per event, through ApprovalLevelNotifier.
Level 1 is deliberately excluded (Current_Level__c > 1): it is told at submit time by InviteeSelectorController, on the proven path that predates the chain. Without this Flow, levels 2 and above would hear nothing at all — their items would appear in the Approvals list unannounced and the batch would stall, which is the one thing a chain adds that a single approver never suffered from.
Like Invitee_Decision_Completion, the Flow is only the trigger: a mass approval advances forty rows in one transaction and the invocable receives all forty ids in one call, so the level above gets one email rather than forty.
Flow.label: Invitee Level Advanced
